title: Campaigne, H. "Key to the Extraterrestrial Messages." NSA Technical Journal Vol. XIV, no. 1, December 31, 1969
doc_notes: This document is an NSA Technical Journal article by H. Campaigne detailing the linguistic and mathematical analysis of a series of 31 coded messages purportedly from outer space.

incidents.summary: A series of 31 coded radio messages from outer space were analyzed to develop a key for translation.
